This page prepares the computer of the learner.

## Goals

::: {.objectives}

- Install Quarto.
- Read the version of Quarto in a terminal.

:::

## Check the version

Open a terminal and run the command.
The command prints one line.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ quarto --version
1.11.9
```

If the terminal prints a version number, Quarto is ready.
